indications: Treatment of mild to moderate pain and fever when clinically appropriate.
adultDose: Use a clinically verified, indication-specific regimen.
pediatricDose: Use a verified weight-based regimen when appropriate.
precautions: Use additional caution in hepatic impairment.
mechanismOfAction: Inhibits prostaglandin synthesis in the central nervous system.
pregnancyConsiderations: Use only when the expected benefit justifies the potential risk.
breastfeedingConsiderations: Use with caution and confirm current guidance.
renalDoseAdjustment: Dose adjustment required only when severe renal impairment is present; confirm current guidance.
hepaticDoseAdjustment: Use caution in hepatic impairment and consider clinical review.
monitoring: Monitor for overdose or prolonged use.
overdoseManagement: Urgent toxicology or emergency evaluation is recommended.
storage: Store according to product-specific instructions and the local label.
prescriptionStatus: Verify current Nepal regulatory status before prescribing.

indications: Used for pain, fever, and inflammatory conditions when clinically suitable.
adultDose: Use a clinically verified, indication-specific regimen.
pediatricDose: Use weight-based dosing and review contraindications.
precautions: Use caution in renal impairment and with aspirin therapy.
pregnancyConsiderations: Avoid or use only under clinician review in pregnancy, particularly late pregnancy.
breastfeedingConsiderations: Assess risk-benefit and use only when clinically justified.
renalDoseAdjustment: Use caution and verify adjustment in renal impairment.
monitoring: Monitor GI symptoms and renal function if prolonged use.
overdoseManagement: Medical review and supportive care are required if overdose is suspected.
prescriptionStatus: Verify current Nepal regulatory status before prescribing.

indications: Used for selected bacterial infections when clinically appropriate and guided by local resistance patterns.
adultDose: Use an evidence-based regimen appropriate to the infection and patient factors.
pediatricDose: Use age and weight-based dosing according to current guidance.
precautions: Review allergy history and monitor for diarrhoea or severe rash.
pregnancyConsiderations: Generally considered acceptable when clinically needed for a bacterial infection.
breastfeedingConsiderations: Usually compatible with breastfeeding when appropriate clinical surveillance is used.
renalDoseAdjustment: Adjust in significant renal impairment according to guidance.
hepaticDoseAdjustment: No major adjustment usually required; verify depending on clinical context.
monitoring: Monitor for allergy and GI symptoms.
overdoseManagement: Supportive care and clinical review are indicated.
storage: Store away from heat and moisture according to label instructions.
prescriptionStatus: Verify current Nepal regulatory status before prescribing.
